t: You're looking at Hallfield Primary School, a two-form-entry primary school on Inverness Terrace, part of the Hallfield Estate in Westminster. The building is Grade II* listed, built between 1953 and 1955, and designed by Denys Lasdun. He's the architect later hailed as the greatest English architect of the early heroic modern period, and best known for the Royal National Theatre on the South Bank. So this is an early work of his, and it's still a working school today.
